nodes.description: Public address state variable initialized to msg.sender at deployment; used as the trusted owner for access control.
Public uint state variable that stores the last completed migration index; written by setCompleted.
Public function setCompleted(uint completed) guarded by the restricted modifier; writes the caller-supplied value into last_completed_migration.
Modifier restricted() that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the modified function body.
Caller-controlled address; used to initialize owner and checked in the restricted modifier.
Caller-supplied uint parameter of setCompleted that is written into last_completed_migration.
State-mutating assignment last_completed_migration = completed executed inside setCompleted after the restricted modifier check.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable at contract construction, fixing the access-control authority.
The restricted modifier reads msg.sender in require(msg.sender == owner), making authorization depend on the caller identity.
The restricted modifier compares the stored owner state variable against msg.sender to grant or deny execution.
The restricted modifier gates execution of setCompleted, so unauthorized callers cannot reach the function body.
The completed parameter is passed into the setCompleted function body.
The completed parameter value flows directly into the state write of last_completed_migration.
setCompleted executes the state-mutating assignment as part of its body.
The unsafe state write updates the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter only exists as the input of setCompleted and does not need an independent semantic node; its value-use can be folded into the function node.
